directory_search.why: Search uses GIN index on search_doc (tsvector) and pg_trgm indexes on display_name/username in osionos_bridge_identities. The view osionos_people_directory joins users + user_profiles + bridge_identities; planner should push predicates to the bridge_identities scan. Budget 150ms allows trigram + FTS union on 10K rows.

directory_by_ids.why: IN list of 50 UUIDs on osionos_bridge_identities.user_id (UNIQUE index). Point lookups via index; 60ms budget covers 50 index probes + profile JSONB construction.

identity_by_email_hash.why: Lookup by email_hash on osionos_bridge_identities has NO index (email_hash is not indexed). Expects Seq Scan on 10K rows. Budget 150ms reflects unindexed scan; this is a known ceiling for P0-5/P1-1 to fix with an index.

feed_shares_for_user.why: Filter on osionos_feed_shares.user_id has NO index (only page_id is indexed). Expects Seq Scan on ~50K rows. Budget 60ms reflects current unindexed scan; P0-5/P1-1 to add index on user_id.

connections_for_user.why: OR condition on requester_id and addressee_id, each with dedicated index (requester_idx, addressee_idx). Planner uses BitmapOr to combine. Budget 60ms covers bitmap heap scan on ~20K rows.

workspace_members_of_large_workspace.why: Lookup by workspace_id (PK leading column) on osionos_workspace_members + PK lookup on osionos_workspaces. Both are index scans. Budget 60ms for joining ~200 member rows with workspace data.

pages_of_workspace.why: Filter on workspace_id + archived_at IS NULL + ORDER BY updated_at DESC uses index osionos_pages_workspace_updated_idx (workspace_id, updated_at DESC). Budget 60ms for index scan with limit 100.
